title: The Legal Practitioners and Bar Councils Amendment Act 2014

sections.shortTitle: The Legal Practitioners and Bar Councils Amendment Act 2014
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

PART 1
The Legal Practitioners and Bar Councils (Amendment) Act 2014
PART 1
Acts, Ordinances, President s Orders and Regulations
NATIONAL ASSEMBLY SECRETARIAT
Islamabad, the 17th June, 2014
No. F. 22
(26)/2013-Legis.- The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the
President on the 15th June, 2014 and is hereby published for general
information:-
ACT No.V OF 2014
An Act further to
amend the Legal Practitioners and Bar Councils Act, 1973
WHEREAS it is expedient further to amend the Legal
Practitioners and Bar Councils Act, 1973 (XXXV of 1973), for the purposes
hereinafter appearing;
it is
hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short title and
commencement.-(1) This Act may be called the Legal Practitioners and Bar
Councils (Amendment) Act, 2014.
(2) It shall come into force at once and except clause (a)
of section 31 which shall come into force on such date as the Federal
Government may, by notification in the official Gazette, specify.
